html:
Insured Home Services Georgia

You can get a free, written, itemized quote for any of our eight trades—Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, Roofing & Tiles, Packing & Moving—served in metro Atlanta and surrounding Georgia. We are licensed and insured in Georgia and respond within one business day.

Our Services

We offer eight trades to help you with your home services needs. Our services include Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, Roofing & Tiles, and Packing & Moving.

What You Get

You get a free, written, itemized quote for our services. Our cost guide, updated August 2026, lists ranges for our services, such as full roof replacement ($9,000-$20,000) and whole-home interior repaint ($3,000-$8,000). We also advise holding back 10-15% for hidden issues.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? We serve Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, and Columbus.

How long does the quote take? We reply within one business day.

What services do you offer? We offer eight trades: Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, Roofing & Tiles, and Packing & Moving.

To get started, fill out the quote form on our website or email us at info@buildheritage.org to request a free, written, itemized quote for our insured home services in Georgia.
